acceptanceCriteria.text: No-key self-host returns engine_unavailable without 500 or uncaught error.
Timeout/unreachable/upstream failures fall back to bounded workspace KB retrieval.
Fallback is tenant-isolated, bounded (top_k <= 5), and never leaks workspace info.
KB fallback citations use real document_id/chunk_id, no fabricated URLs.
Parse explicit partial, insufficientEvidence, and heartbeat events; heartbeat is liveness.
REST sync, async, agent, and MCP doors return the same typed degradation contract.
Observability includes degradation reason, fallback hit count, and blocked URL coverage counters without secrets.
No fake billing for engine_unavailable no-content responses.
Public-repo gate evidence reproducible with ChainLens unconfigured.
